_comment: Curated, hand-maintained classification of remediation task type per daf, used by generate_rashi_docs.py to render the scaffold-status table. Entries here override the default classification computed from the current baseline's rule mix. Add a daf here only when its correct task type cannot be inferred purely from which rules currently hit it (e.g. the 2b/3a/3b/7b low-severity cluster, which is a separately-tracked pre-existing workstream, not part of the active reconstruction queue).
